# Feature spec templates

Used by `scripts/spec-create.sh` to create `specs/NNN-slug/` (or `SPEC_ROOT`).

Files per feature:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `SPEC.md` | What to build — requirements, acceptance criteria |
| `PLAN.md` | How — technical approach, stack touchpoints |
| `TASKS.md` | Ordered task list with IDs and deps |
| `PROGRESS.md` | Status, blockers, dated updates for this spec |

Numbering: `001-`, `002-`, … (zero-padded, sortable).
